title: Python check one localhost port
description: Check a single service port on loopback.
code:
import socket

host, port = '127.0.0.1', 8000
with socket.socket() as sock:
    sock.settimeout(2)
    result = sock.connect_ex((host, port))
print('Open' if result == 0 else 'Not open')

title: Python inspect HTTP server response
description: Inspect status and headers from your local practice web server.
code:
from urllib.request import urlopen

url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'
with urlopen(url, timeout=3) as response:
    print('Status:', response.status)
    print('Headers:', response.headers)

title: Calculate subnet details
description: Calculate network, broadcast and usable address count.
code:
import ipaddress

net = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.56.0/24')
print('Network:', net.network_address)
print('Broadcast:', net.broadcast_address)
print('Hosts:', net.num_addresses - 2)

title: Check whether an IP belongs to a lab subnet
description: Validate that a target address is inside your explicitly defined lab subnet.
code:
import ipaddress

lab = ipaddress.ip_network('192.168.56.0/24')
target = ipaddress.ip_address('192.168.56.10')
print('Inside lab:', target in lab)

title: Create a lab asset inventory CSV
description: Create a small inventory file for assets you own; enter only lab devices.
code:
import csv

assets = [
    {'name': 'local-web-lab', 'ip': '127.0.0.1', 'owner': 'me'},
]
with open('lab-assets.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=assets[0].keys())
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(assets)
print('Saved lab-assets.csv')
